why: #50003 Forum top page behind experiments.forum: ForumTopPage (an InternalPageProvider like StashTopPage and BookmarksTopPage) needs AppServices, DaemonPageRelay and PageConnectionWatch, which are App types; its registration, setting-off reason and sidebar action wiring sit beside the App Store's in TopPages.swift and SidebarBridge+Sections.swift. Everything that can live in a domain package does (Sidebar, Pages, Settings, Compat, Daemon). The factory was folded into the provider to keep the growth down.
